note: Kentucky State Parks resort-park campground in wooded pod loops on a ridge above Dale Hollow Lake, about 0.5 km from the water; the 24 sites in pods P-R are for horse campers only. Country store and mini golf at the campground entrance; lodge, restaurant, golf course, marina and horse and hiking trails in the park. --Claude
